newsitem.title: USA: Minyuan to acquire AVIC option.
newsitem.headline: Minyuan to acquire AVIC option.

text.p: AVIC Group International Inc said Monday Hainan Minyuan Modern Agriculture Co has agreed to purchase a company holding an option to acquire 45 percent of AVIC's outstanding common shares.

Minyuan directors and shareholders have approved an agreement to acquire Beijing Catch Communications Group, a state-run telecommunications company operating the second largest paging network in China, which previously owned the option, AVIC explained. The approvals came at a special shareholder's meeting held on October 21.
The acquisition was approved last month by Beijing's city government.
AVIC also said Ma Yuhe, Minyuan's chairman, and Yang Bao Hua, a Minyuan director, will join AVIC's board, increasing its membership to eight from six.
